subtitle: Lesson 113 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

eyebrow: The single biggest technique: consistent order
caption: Same order, every time -- the cyclical wait can't form.

code:
-- Keep transactions SHORT (less time holding a lock)
-- Use the lightest isolation level that's still correct
-- Add helpful indexes (less scan time = less lock time)
caption: All reduce the window where a conflicting cycle can form.
